summary: authID Inc. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing a Backstop Commitment Agreement with holders of its senior secured debentures (issued under the April 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement). The commitment parties agreed, severally, to backstop up to $300,000 (or $500,000 if a third-party strategic funding occurs), with $300,000 funded September 11, 2026. The Company issued 750,000 five-year commitment fee warrants, exercisable immediately, regardless of drawdown. The filing also cites unregistered equity sales under Item 3.02. Watch liquidity, warrant overhang and any strategic-investor financing contingency.
